name: Unemployment Rate
description: The share of the labour force aged 15 and above that is without work but seeking it, measured by current weekly status in the monthly PLFS. In September 2026 the rate was 4.2% in rural areas and 6.9% in urban areas.
releaseSchedule: Released monthly, around the 15th, for the previous month.

chart.source: MoSPI PLFS monthly press note, 15 Oct 2026
